opportunities.name: Movie night invite: IMDb + Rotten Tomatoes lookup, then draft email
opportunities.description: For a given movie, look up it on IMDb and Rotten Tomatoes, collect director/runtime/IMDb rating/Tomatometer, then compose an invite email to a person with day and movie details.
steps: Search the movie title on IMDb and open its page; note director, runtime, IMDb rating
Search the title on Rotten Tomatoes and open its page; note Tomatometer
Enter body 'Hi <name>, <Day> we watch <Movie> (<director>, <runtime>): IMDb <rating>, Tomatometer <pct>.'

instances.values: Arrival, lena@example.com, Friday, Denis Villeneuve 1h56m, IMDb 7.9, RT 94%
Spirited Away, tom@example.com, Saturday, Hayao Miyazaki 2h4m, IMDb 8.6, RT 96%
The Grand Budapest Hotel, aisha@example.com, Sunday, Wes Anderson 1h39m, IMDb 8.1, RT 92%

opportunities.name: npm package research note: npm + GitHub releases + notes
opportunities.description: For a given npm package, search npm, open the package, follow its GitHub repo to Releases, then record version, weekly downloads, license, stars, open issues and last release in Notes.
steps: Search the package name on npmjs.com and open the exact-match package
Open Releases; note stars, open issues, last release date
Open Notes, add note '<pkg>: <version>, <downloads>/week, <license>, <stars> stars, <issues> open issues, last release <date>' and press Enter

opportunities.name: Recipe research note: Allrecipes + Wikipedia origin + notes
opportunities.description: For a given dish, search Allrecipes and open the top recipe, look up the dish origin on Wikipedia, then record servings, rating, time, key ingredients and origin in Notes.
steps: Search the dish on Allrecipes and open the top result
Search the dish on Wikipedia and read the origin
Open Notes, add '<dish> for <n>: <recipe> (<rating> stars, <time>), needs <ingredients>. Origin: <origin>' and press Enter

instances.values: pad thai (after lemon tart detours), 2 servings, Thailand
